name: Probationer on the Simple profile at 85%, no PIT
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: The position's official salary is 20,000,000; probation pay is the statutory minimum share, 85% (probation.limits.minimumPayPercent) = 17,000,000.
22 of 22 working days paid, so the base is not cut: 17,000,000 x 2200 / 2200 = 17,000,000.
Simple profile: no compulsory insurance and no union at all, whatever the exemption says (SRS D18).
The entity's policy taxes the Simple profile as 'none', so no PIT is withheld — FR-PAY-07 makes this a parameter, not a rule in code.
Net = gross = 17,000,000; the employer cost is the same, with nothing on top.
